newsitem.title: JAPAN: NGK rises in morning on share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: NGK rises in morning on share repurchase.

text.p: NGK Insulators Ltd shares were higher on Friday morning, inspired by news after Thursday's close that the firm was planning a share repurchase, brokers said.
As of 0039 GMT, NGK shares were up 10 yen at 1,180 on turnover totalling 2.39 million shares, making it the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
On Thursday, NGK said it had decided to buy back up to 10 million of its own shares or up to 15 billion yen worth of shares.
Brokers said that investors were also heartened by the major insulation manufacturer's earnings forecast.
NGK's group net profits are projected to rise to 13.00 billion yen in the year to end-March 1998 from 11.02 billion a year earlier.
